en.headline: BIGBANG 20th anniversary media exhibition opens at Festival Walk today
en.dek: The COSMOS show runs from 18 November to 27 December at the Kowloon Tong mall, with themed zones, holograms and official merchandise.
body: The BIGBANG 20th Anniversary Media Exhibition COSMOS opens today at Festival Walk in Kowloon Tong and runs until 27 December.

Organised by Clement Shield Entertainment Production Company Limited, the show features multiple themed zones that combine mirrored motion graphics, projection walls, holograms and virtual-reality experiences. Content is split into two phases, with Phase 1 running from 18 November to 7 December and Phase 2 from 8 to 27 December.

Sessions last one hour and the venue is open from 11am to 10pm daily at Shop MTR-02A. Tickets cost HK$150 plus a HK$20 handling fee. Official limited-edition merchandise, including Hong Kong-exclusive items, is available on site.
The exhibition is the first overseas stop of the anniversary media show following its run in South Korea. Festival Walk has published the full schedule and zone details on its website.

zh.headline: BIGBANG二十周年媒體展《COSMOS》今日於又一城開幕
zh.dek: 展覽由11月18日至12月27日在九龍塘又一城舉行，設主題展區、全息投影及官方周邊。
body: BIGBANG成軍二十周年媒體展《COSMOS》香港站今日於九龍塘又一城正式開幕，展期至12月27日。
由Clement Shield Entertainment Production Company Limited主辦的展覽設多個主題展區，結合鏡面動態影像、投影牆、全息投影及虛擬實境體驗。內容分兩階段呈現，第一階段由11月18日至12月7日，第二階段由12月8日至27日。
每日開放時間為上午11時至晚上10時，每節一小時，地點為MTR-02A號舖。門票售價150元，另加20元手續費。場內設有官方限定周邊，包括香港站獨家商品。
這是該媒體展在韓國結束後的首個海外站。又一城已在其網站公布完整時間表及展區詳情。
